label: Demo video renderer (presentation only: draws an existing replay run; no inference, no reference data, no thresholds)
corner_label: THUD++ replay: reference depth, placeholder passage and gestures
codec_note: avc1 = H.264 in MP4 (plays in Windows Media Player / Films & TV, macOS QuickTime, PowerPoint, browsers); OpenCV writes it through Media Foundation on Windows and AVFoundation on macOS. mp4v (MPEG-4 Part 2) is a fallback that QuickTime may refuse; the codec actually written is read back and recorded in run_info.json.
playback: real time: fps = (frames - 1) / (last timestamp - first timestamp) of the replay run
stills: one per decision (STOP, MOVE, WAIT): the middle frame of that decision's longest contiguous run of frames with a person visible (else of its longest run), unless --still DECISION=FRAME_INDEX is given
stills_rule_change: 2026-10-17, presentation only: the first render (outputs/demo_video_1388f_20261017_000506) used the middle of the longest run, which gave MOVE and WAIT stills without any person; the person-visible preference was added after seeing them
